episode_summary: In this episode, Kelsey Caputo discusses the transformative role of AI in real estate, particularly in the luxury market. She highlights the importance of combining AI insights with local expertise to provide exceptional client service. Kelsey also shares strategies for using AI to anticipate buyer objections and target specific markets for luxury listings.
